statement: >= 15 distinct organisations with a >= 1e26 FLOP run (shared with I-N-01; counted once per family) (Epoch AI; 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: 0 organisations known to have a >= 1e26 FLOP run by end-2023 (same evidence family as I-N-01; do not double-count). Largest public estimate ~2e25 FLOP; the 1e26 level was adopted by Bloc A as a reporting trigger for future models. Open-weight releases from several organisations (incl. a new non-Bloc-A/B lab) were far below the threshold.

items.summary: Bloc A's interim reporting threshold of 1e26 operations was set above every publicly known model, implying zero organisations at that scale in-phase.
The largest in-phase compute estimate for any model was about 2.2e25 FLOP (third-party estimate for the March 2023 frontier model), below 1e26.
items.detail: LessWrong retrospective (2023-03-17) citing Epoch AI ~2.2e25 FLOP for GPT-4; figure seen in search snippet, possible later edit.

items.summary: A young lab outside Bloc A and Bloc B released an open-weight sparse mixture-of-experts model matching or beating the previous-generation proprietary model on most benchmarks, showing new entrants at the sub-frontier scale but nowhere near 1e26.
items.detail: Mistral AI (Bloc E), 'Mixtral of experts', 2023-12-11; Mixtral 8x7B, Apache 2.0; trained with CoreWeave and Scaleway support.
